snippet.title: BOIIING BOIIING - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist "Boiiing Boiiing" on Steam now! 
Release date: Early 2026

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3521770/Boiiing_Boiiing?utm_source=youtube

Boiiing Boiiing is a physics-based party game up to 5 players in local, where you play as animals that chase each other using pogo sticks and unique powers.
